diagnosis.failure_mode: The policy network is not being updated during training. Policy loss remains at essentially zero (order of 1e-7 to 1e-8), entropy stays constant at exactly 0.6931 (ln(2) - indicating a frozen uniform binary policy), KL divergence is exactly 0.0, and clip fraction is 0.0 throughout all training iterations. Meanwhile, the value function learns normally (explained variance increases from ~0 to ~0.47, value loss decreases). This indicates the policy gradient computation returns zero gradients or the policy optimizer is not applying updates to the policy parameters, while the value function optimizer works correctly. The policy remains frozen at its initialization (uniform random policy).
